findings.consequence: If pallets back up or jam at the conveyor entry, the condition will never be detected. Motor Y10 will keep running, risking conveyor mechanical damage, motor overload, or battery enclosure damage, and no jam alarm will be annunciated.
findings.evidence: According to cause-and-effect matrix CE-ST10-03, parameter sheet (jam_time 5.0 s on T10), and narrative §3, conveyor entry photo-eye PE-1002 (X11) blocked for more than 5.0 s while the conveyor motor is running must stop the conveyor and raise a latched jam alarm. In the program, R2 resets M190 and R3 reads M190, but M190 is never set anywhere, T10 is never instantiated, and X11 is completely unused (confirmed by lint L005).
findings.proposed_fix: Add jam detection logic before R2: condition timer T10 on conveyor running and entry photo-eye blocked ('LD Y10', 'AND X11', 'OUT T10 K50'). When T10 is done, latch jam alarm M190 ('LD T10', 'SET M190'). Ensure R2 clears M190 on fault reset PB X1 ('LD X1', 'RST M190').
findings.title: Missing Jam Detection Logic and Timer T10

findings.consequence: Spontaneous, unexpected restarting of conveyor motor M-1001 when a thermal overload auto-resets, presenting an unexpected restart and pinch hazard to personnel inspecting the machine, in violation of machinery safety standards and narrative §4.8 requiring alarms to be latched until reset.
findings.evidence: R1 drives M191 using non-retentive coil 'OUT M191' from 'LDI X13' (overload healthy contact). When MOL-1001 trips, X13 opens (0), setting M191 and stopping Y10 via M199. However, once the thermal overload cools and recloses (X13 returns to 1), M191 immediately drops out. R2 does not reset M191, and R4 will immediately restart Y10 if auto mode switch SS-0003 (X2) is still selected.
findings.proposed_fix: Latch the motor overload alarm using 'LDI X13', 'SET M191'. In R2, add a reset rung requiring fault reset PB-0002 and confirmed healthy overload: 'LD X1', 'AND X13', 'RST M191'.
findings.title: Unlatched Motor Overload Alarm M191 Permitting Spontaneous Restart

findings.consequence: Stopper release solenoid XY-1004 can drop the stopper in manual mode, during an active station fault, or when E-stop is tripped. If E-stop is activated during release, the stopper does not abort or re-extend immediately, potentially allowing pallets to roll into an unsafe cell.
findings.evidence: R6 pulses 'SET Y11' unconditionally on the rising edge of release request RQ-1005 ('LDP X14'). There are no interlocks ensuring the station is in Auto mode (X2), that E-stop is healthy (X0), or that ST10 is free of faults (M199). Furthermore, if an E-stop occurs while Y11 is set, Y11 remains energized until timer T11 completes its 2.0 s timing because there is no reset on E-stop trip.
findings.proposed_fix: Interlock R6 with Auto mode, E-stop healthy, and no fault: 'LD X2', 'AND X0', 'ANI M199', 'ANDP X14', 'SET Y11'. In addition, add an immediate reset condition for Y11 on loss of E-stop or fault: 'LDI X0', 'OR M199', 'RST Y11'.
findings.title: Missing Operational and Safety Interlocks on Stopper Release Solenoid Y11

findings.consequence: Maintenance technicians reviewing the IL listing cannot readily identify what M190 or M199 signify, increasing troubleshooting time and risk of erroneous edits during downtime.
findings.evidence: Internal bits M190 (jam alarm) and M199 (ST10 fault/inhibit), as well as physical output Y10 (M-1001) and input X1 (PB-0002), lack comments in <device_comments> and/or rung comment documentation in ST10.
findings.proposed_fix: Add standard device comments in the project database: M190: 'ST10 pallet jam alarm', M199: 'ST10 conveyor fault / run inhibit', Y10: 'M-1001 conveyor motor contactor', X1: 'PB-0002 fault reset PB'.
findings.title: Missing Device Comments for Internal Fault and Run Inhibit Relays

data.summary: Engineering review of ST10 identified four key defects: (1) jam detection logic (X11, T10, M190) is completely missing despite being mandated by CE-ST10-03 and the parameter sheet; (2) motor overload alarm M191 is unlatched with OUT, allowing hazardous spontaneous conveyor restart upon thermal cooling; (3) stopper release solenoid Y11 lacks Auto, E-stop, and fault interlocks and fails to abort on E-stop; and (4) essential internal relays M190 and M199 lack descriptive device comments.
